channel.title: Sebastián Allende — Writing
channel.description: Notes on running ERP and financial systems in production.

item.title: The bugs that survive an ERP upgrade are the quiet ones
item.description: Migrating five major versions forward across four companies and three countries. The failures that raised errors were fixed in days; the ones that changed behaviour without raising anything lasted weeks.

item.title: Alert quality beats alert count
item.description: Building a health check that reconciles inventory against the general ledger every six hours, what it found that no report showed, and why an alert nobody acts on is a defect rather than a nuisance.
